name: Pipeline coverage
description: Open pipeline closing in a quota period divided by quota for the same period. 3.0 means pipeline is three times quota. The target is 3.00x.
notes: Total (unweighted) coverage. Coverage by region is a view of this metric, not a separate formula. The target 3.00x is confirmed. Below 2.00x is red, from 2.00x up to the target is amber, and at or above the target is green. The 2.00x color boundary is the plan's split. The target and the color boundary are display-only and do not change the computed value.
